source: lab (captured, background replaced by a blue backdrop - 'Modified with Segment Anything' watermark bottom right)

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of table/ramp region vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.1 px at frames 12, 24, 36, 48)

perspective.table_top_is_trapezoid: front edge ~640 px wide (x 280-923 at y~535-539), back edge ~327 px (x ~440-767 at y ~442; the board stands in front of its middle)
perspective.vanishing_point_uncertainty: +-40 px in x, +-25 px in y (rounded corners and noisy matte along the back edge; using back corners (500,436)/(765,442) instead gives (644,370))
perspective.note: horizon close to the principal point row (360) -> optical axis roughly horizontal if the table is level; the camera is a little above the table top (top surface visible). The book slides towards the camera (down the image) and grows

book.description: closed book / thick notebook, pale blue-grey cover (top face), cream page block, a thin yellow-green bookmark string sticking out of its LEFT end (visible on the table from ~f34)
book.role: the only moving object; sits on top of the inclined white board, slides down it towards the camera, drops onto the table top and stops in front of the board
book.reference_point: centre of the bounding box of the whole visible book (cover + page block) = ref_x, ref_y

end_rest.note: left edge 474-478 jitters with the bookmark string; true page-block left edge ~480 (zoom). cover top ~479-482, bottom contact line 508-511

book.apparent_length_change: horizontal length (long axis, across the motion direction) 125 px on the ramp top -> 175 px at rest on the table: ratio 1.40, i.e. it ends ~1.4x closer to the camera

ramp_board.description: white rigid board (inclined plane) leaning on/standing on the table, top edge far from the camera, bottom edge on the table near the camera; appears as a trapezoid
ramp_board.note: bottom edge shows a dark line at y 482-484 (centre columns); the book covers its top edge region in frames 0-22

table.description: wooden table, brown top (wood grain, glossy - reflects the white board), dark front face, single dark grey pedestal leg
table.row_extents: see static_measure.json (left/right edge x every 5 rows)

leg.note: runs off the bottom of the frame

table.note: back edge outline is noisy (segmentation matte); back corners +-8 px

events.event: book at rest on top of the ramp
start of sliding (first centre displacement, release)
events.note: bbox moves first at f21 (+1.5 px down); onset between f20 and f21

events.event: accelerating slide down the ramp, toward the camera
events.note: per-frame vertical centre step grows 1.5,3,4.5,5,7.5,8.5,10.5,12,14,15.5 px

events.event: front (lower) end of the book reaches the bottom of the ramp / table
events.note: bbox bottom 481 = ramp bottom edge 480-483; book yaws ~8 deg in the image at f29-31 (right end lower)

events.event: book leaves the ramp and drops onto the table top (impact)
events.note: lies flat (tilt 0, height 32 px) by f33

events.event: slides on the table and stops
events.note: steps 10.5, 7, 2.5, 3.5, 2 px; at rest from f37 (t = 1.542 s)

events.event: at rest on the table in front of the ramp
